The next largest real functions are 238 lines (claude-cli.js run) and the nested planRun of 96 lines; the largest file outside team and web in tools/src is mask.js with 1098 lines, so the file sizes are in the range of the neighbours (engine.js 1086, channel.js 989, store.js 951) and the closures are the outliers. summary.text: The team core and the web server match the line-by-line reading of decisions 0017 to 0026, 0095, 0102 and 0105 in the points that matter: 37 events and the five core-only types, one journal write with one fsync and a rollback, the lock check inside the write call, no import of web by the team, no write to files by the web, no network in the team except the one child process file, all routes and codes as designed. No Critical or High finding. The two Medium findings: decision 0025 W2 and the REQ-011 design were not updated after the access-key change (ISS-0122), and there is no test of a disk failure on the second file of a result set (the earlier files stay by decision 0105, only the secret case is tested). Low: the scripted executor charges a run stopped before it started, the executor files import each other in a circle, copied helpers, 32 names exported without a user, and three very large functions.
